finding.text: The diff does not contain the work it is meant to review: it is ~198 files of `files.jsonl`/`page.jsonl` list churn (session pages marked `gone`) plus two one-line readme links (Figma). The skill edits and `claude-md-proposal.md` sit in earlier commits, so I judged them from `git log`, `requirements.md` and the load tables, not from the patch.

The shots are of 16 unrelated day and task pages whose `page.jsonl` list changed, not of the system-architect page. Layout, sizing, wrapping, spacing and colour answers below are therefore about those pages and show no regression from this diff.

Requirements 5 says a deleted skill moves to `.claude/skills-archive/`; that folder does not exist. No skill was deleted (`servex-mastermind` is still in `.claude/skills/`, marked retired), so nothing broke. The overlap the owner named (mastermind / sub-mastermind / servex-mastermind / master-assistant / every-prompt) is trimmed but not merged: `mastermind` is still 7,982 words, the largest skill.

`shots/…ai2-2026-09-25-cards-that-show-the-thing/layout.json` reports `widest_text` 3938 at 400, a raw JSON string shown as text. It predates this diff (only the file list changed) but is a real wrapping defect on that page.

The diff is not this task's work (Requirements 1–5). The system-architect deliverables (measure.mjs, the skill, page.js, doc/findings.md, claude-md-proposal.md) were already committed (c000c13c8, 7e0ccf7f9, fac6cdd77, d34ddf2ac). This patch is uncommitted work from a different ask: `Server/OrphanCheck.mjs`, the merge.mjs warning, `children: "… auto"` in `Page.declare()` and `ext/page.js`, and the indexing doc answer. Give that work its own task and its own review; don't land it under system-architect.

About 200 of the patch's ~440 added lines are watcher noise: `{"file":"shots/","gone":true}` and `layout-check/` "gone" lines appended to `files.jsonl` / `page.jsonl` in about 180 old task dirs. Those dirs still exist on disk (for example `ai/2026-08-17/designtool-ui/shots/`), so the lines record something false. Drop them from the commit rather than landing them.

No shot shows a page this work changed in a way you can see. 32 of the 33 shot dirs are `ai/<date>` task pages whose only change is a noise line. The system-architect page itself was never shot. `ext/` (the one page `auto` changes) has a 53309 shot only, with no matching 56480 shot to compare against.

The `ext/` shots don't prove `auto` works. `shots/127-0-0-1-53309-framework-ext/1200.png` shows only the first 24 cards, and Figma and DataGrid (both have a page.js) would sort after the named children, below the fold. `child_source` runs only through `child()` / `load_all_children()`, so check that the previews wall and the sidebar both show them.
`Page.declare()` removes only the first `auto` (non-global replace), and a child folder literally named `auto` can no longer be declared. Name it in `doc/indexing-2026-10-08.md`'s caveats.
Every page logs a 404 (`layout.json` errors, every width, every page). This was probably there before the change, but nobody has checked.

The diff does not contain this task's work: it is 531 `files.jsonl` bookkeeping appends, 20 `page.jsonl` appends, an old `ai-system-docs/review.md`, and one-line Figma entries in `readme.md` and `ai/readme.md`. The skill merges, `claude-md-proposal.md` and `page.js` landed earlier (git log: fac6cdd77, cbb06d331, d926f8538). Requirements are judged from the log and the files, not from this diff.
The Figma lines in `readme.md` and `ai/readme.md` belong to a different task. They are harmless: each is one line and links to `ext/Figma`.

The shots are of 17 unrelated `/framework/ai/...` day and task pages, not of `system-architect/` itself, so this task's own page has no layout evidence. At 400 the widest of them has `empty` 0.783 (`shots/...-2026-10-09/layout.json`). The page has not changed layout, so I count it as old.
The 79 lines added to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl` are an auto-written log. Nothing to review.
